entries.source: ⁅自動⁆あなたのエンドフェイズ開始時、あなたの山札を上から１枚見て、そのカードをあなたの、山札の上か墓地に置く。

previous_job.translation: ⁅Auto⁆At the beginning of your End Phase, look at the top card of your deck, then put that card on top of your deck or into your graveyard.

entries.translation: ⁅Auto⁆At the beginning of your End Phase, look at the top card of your deck, then put that card on top of your deck or into your graveyard.
entries.reviewer: assistant editorial review; not human certification
entries.rationale: Accepted the natural singular "the top card": it denotes exactly 1 card. The numeric warning is a false positive, explicitly accepted for this field only; automatic validation remains unchanged.

entries.source: ⁅自動⁆このユニットがバトル中に破壊された時、あなたのライフがレッドゾーンなら、総コスト６以下のバトル相手を破壊する。

entries.translation: ⁅Auto⁆When this unit is destroyed during battle, if your life is in the Red Zone, destroy the unit it was battling if that unit has total cost 6 or less.
entries.reviewer: assistant editorial review; not human certification
entries.rationale: Resolved battle opponent as the specific unit involved in the battle. Preserved the destruction timing, Red Zone condition and total-cost threshold; no target selection was added.

entries.source: 古来より存在する邪眼の力を、マーギュリスは極限まで高めた。

previous_job.translation: Margulis has heightened the power of the evil eye, which has existed since ancient times, to its utmost limit.
previous_job.notes: The proper name マーギュリス is not listed in the glossary; “Margulis” is a consistent transliteration candidate.

entries.translation: Margulis pushed the ancient power of the evil eye to its utmost limits.
entries.reviewer: assistant editorial review; not human certification
entries.rationale: Approved Margulis as a project transliteration of マーギュリス, not a verified official Build Divide spelling. Preserved the completed action and the reference to an ancient evil-eye power.

previous_job.notes: 「交戦」は not listed in the attributes glossary; “Engagement” is a candidate translation, but the intended attribute terminology is uncertain.

entries.reviewer: assistant editorial review; not human certification
entries.rationale: Adopted Combat as the project English label for the attribute 交戦. This is an editorial convention, not verified official English terminology.

previous_job.notes: 瞋怒 is an uncommon Buddhist-derived term for anger or wrath; “Wrath” is a candidate rendering.

entries.reviewer: assistant editorial review; not human certification
entries.rationale: Accepted the descriptive title: 瞋怒 means wrath/anger and 身を焦がす describes scorching the body. No uncertain proper-name reading is involved.

entries.source:
あなたのエナジーが５枚以上なら、あなたの称号「焔」のテリトリーを開放し、あなたは１枚引いて１枚捨てる。⁅鋼の錬金術師 FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST⁆を捨てたら、その後、相手のユニットを１枚対象とし、対象に8000ダメージ。
⁅起動⁆〔ノーマル/手札からこのカードを捨てる〕：【等価交換４】。
（あなたの錬成カウンターを４個取り除くことで、自分の墓地から総コスト４以下のコマンドカードをリムーブしそれをコピーできる）

previous_job.translation:
If you have 5 or more energy, open your «Flame» territory, then draw 1 card and discard 1 card. If you discarded ⁅鋼の錬金術師 FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST⁆, then target 1 of your opponent’s units and deal it 8000 damage.
⁅Activated⁆ [Normal / Discard this card from your hand]: [Equivalent Exchange 4].
(Remove 4 of your Alchemy Counters to remove a command card with total cost 4 or less from your graveyard and copy it.)
previous_job.notes: Japanese remains; check terminology; The title «焔» is rendered as “Flame” descriptively; the project glossary does not establish its English name. The phrase “discarded __BD_TOKEN_000__” is retained literally because the placeholder’s meaning is unavailable.

entries.translation:
If you have 5 or more energy cards, open your territory with the title “Flame,” then draw 1 card and discard 1 card. If you discarded a ⁅Fullmetal Alchemist⁆ card this way, then choose 1 of your opponent's units as a target and deal 8000 damage to it.
⁅Activated⁆ [Normal / Discard this card from your hand]: 【Equivalent Exchange 4】.
(You may remove 4 of your Alchemy Counters to remove a Command card with total cost 4 or less from your graveyard and copy it.)
entries.reviewer: assistant editorial review; not human certification
entries.rationale: Restored the explicit title requirement 称号「焔」 rather than implying a territory named Flame. Clarified that the franchise marker qualifies the discarded card. Preserved energy-card count, draws/discards, damage target, activation cost, timing, counter payment and copy threshold. English rules terminology remains a project convention.

entries.source:
⁅永続⁆あなたのテリトリーが無いなら、テリトリーゾーンからこのカードをプレイできる。（この面で登場する）
⁅自動⁆このユニットがアタックした時、あなたのテリトリーが無いなら、相手は自身の山札を上から11枚リムーブすることで、このアタックを中止できる。
⁅永続⁆このユニットがフィールドを離れる際、代わりにテリトリーゾーンに置く。

※「第九層シバルバー」の効果
（デッキ構築の際、このカード⁅☆⁆1枚に数える）
「第九層シバルバー」はデッキに1枚しか入れられない。
ゲーム開始時、この面を表にしてテリトリーゾーンに置く。

previous_job.translation:
⁅Continuous⁆If you have no territory, you may play this card from the Territory Zone. (It appears on this side.)
⁅Auto⁆When this unit attacks, if you have no territory, your opponent may cancel this attack by removing the top 11 cards of their deck.
⁅Continuous⁆When this unit would leave the field, put it in the Territory Zone instead.

※Effect of “Ninth Layer Shibalbar”
(This card counts as ⁅☆⁆1 card when building your deck.)
You can include only 1 “Ninth Layer Shibalbar” in your deck.
At the start of the game, put this side face up in the Territory Zone.
previous_job.notes: 「シバルバー」 has no established glossary rendering; “Shibalbar” is a consistent transliteration candidate.

entries.translation:
⁅Continuous⁆If you have no territory, you may play this card from the Territory Zone. (It enters the field on this side.)
⁅Auto⁆When this unit attacks, if you have no territory, your opponent may cancel this attack by removing the top 11 cards of their deck.
⁅Continuous⁆When this unit would leave the field, put it in the Territory Zone instead.

※Effect of “Ninth Layer Xibalba”
(This card counts as 1 ⁅☆⁆ card for deck construction.)
You may include only 1 “Ninth Layer Xibalba” in your deck.
At the start of the game, put this side face up in the Territory Zone.
entries.reviewer: assistant editorial review; not human certification
entries.rationale: Replaced unsupported Shibalbar with the established franchise name Xibalba; Ninth Layer is the descriptive translation of 第九層. Preserved both no-territory conditions, the opponent's optional 11-card removal, replacement effect and deck-construction instructions. This is a project translation of the card name, not an official English card localization.

entries.source: ダ・ヴィンチ「ORTも九層に浮上した！ 霊気出力も規模も、さっきとは桁違いだ！」

previous_job.translation: Da Vinci: “ORT has risen to the ninth layer, too! Its spiritual energy output and scale are on a completely different level from before!”
previous_job.notes: The meaning of 霊気 (translated here as “spiritual energy”) is uncertain in this context.

entries.translation: Da Vinci: “ORT has surfaced at the ninth layer too! Its spiritual energy output and sheer scale are on a completely different level from before!”
entries.reviewer: assistant editorial review; not human certification
entries.rationale: Accepted spiritual energy as a literal rendering of 霊気. Did not substitute Spirit Origin (霊基), which would change the Japanese source. Preserved Da Vinci's speech, location and comparison with the previous state.
